title: One local representative agrees with the transported target section
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion, $q:U\to X$ etale, $h:X\prime\to X$ any morphism, and $F$ an etale sheaf of sets. Let $t$ be a global section of $i^*F$ and $s\in F(U)$ whose unit image under $i$ is the restriction of $t$ to $U\times_X Z$. Use the explicit constructions of [def-weil-pbc-gabber-h0-zariski-constructions], including $G,H,t_H$ and the local representative. For a single open $W\subset X\prime$ and $\phi:W\to U$ with $\phi\circ q=W.\iota\circ h$, and every unit-compatible $\beta:i\prime_{Zar}^*G\to H$, the image under $\beta$ of the Zariski unit of the local representative is $t_H$ restricted to $i\prime^{-1}W$. No covering hypothesis or global lifting conclusion is assumed. The closed immersion, etale objects, sheaves, pullbacks and units are [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets, def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units].

Use the local representative comparison, then the global target comparison in the reverse direction. Naturality of the composition isomorphism moves restriction back to the iterated inverse-image sheaf. Cancel the component to obtain the required equation.

theorem gabber_h0_zariski_representative_equation
    {X Z U X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (q : U ⟶ X) [Etale q] (h : X' ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))))
    (s : F.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk q)))
    (hs : etaleSetDescentUnit i F (Scheme.Etale.mk q) s =
      ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).map
          (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk q (Category.comp_id q) :
            Scheme.Etale.mk q ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).op t)
    (W : X'.Opens) (phi : W.toScheme ⟶ U) (hphi : phi ≫ q = W.ι ≫ h)
    (beta : (gabberZariskiPull (pullback.snd i h)).obj (gabberZariskiG h F) ⟶
      gabberZariskiH i h F)
    (hbeta : GabberZariskiUnitCompatible i h F beta) :
    beta.hom.app (op ((pullback.snd i h) ⁻¹ᵁ W))
      (gabberZariskiUnit (pullback.snd i h) (gabberZariskiG h F) W
        (gabberLocalRepresentative q h F s W phi hphi)) =
      (gabberZariskiH i h F).obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op
        (gabberZariskiTargetSection i h F t)
